snippet.title: Anima Gate of Memories I&II Remaster Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592140/Anima_Gate_of_Memories_I__II_Remastered/

Two epic stories. One remastered journey.

Anima Gate of Memories I&II Remaster brings together two acclaimed action RPGs in a single, enhanced edition — with improved visuals, and refined gameplay.

Discover a fantasy world made of memories and and be part of war in the shadows. Whether you're a longtime fan or diving in for the first time, this is the ultimate Anima experience.
